name: io.github.croviatrust/causari
title: Causari
description: Records what an AI agent runtime declared it did in a repo (prompt, model, files) and reports which recorded event a line came from, with the evidence class (declared, correlated, or observed). It does not prove who typed the line.

packageArguments.description: Run the stdio MCP server (the same binary is also the `re` command line).
